description: Bowling Score Calculator — real 10-frame scoring with strikes, spares and 10th-frame bonuses, entered frame by frame.

faqs.a: Strike = 10 plus your next two balls. Spare = 10 plus your next one ball. That's why a strike can be worth up to 30.
faqs.q: How do strike and spare bonuses work?

faqs.a: Strike on the first ball and you get two more balls (pins reset). Spare the first two and you get one bonus ball. Otherwise the frame ends at two balls.
A perfect game is 12 strikes = 300. The calculator handles it correctly.
faqs.q: What is a perfect game worth?

howto: Enter pins for each ball, frame by frame.
Pin limits update automatically (e.g. no 2nd ball after a strike).
Cumulative scores appear as each frame becomes final.
title: Bowling Score Calculator
